title: Building software one system at a time.
body: This website documents projects, technical decisions, and experiments built with an architecture-first mindset. Every project is treated as a long-term system designed to remain understandable, maintainable, and continuously improved.
philosophy_1: Good software is rarely the result of writing more code. It comes from making better decisions before the first line is written.
philosophy_2: One must imagine d3f4lt happy pushing code into the void.
outside: When I am not building something, I am usually reading, playing osu!, or exploring random ideas that catch my attention.
contact_intro: For direct communication or collaboration inquiries.
